limitations: Geometry-only dense world-space offsets; masks/colors remain base channels, and no reference layer equivalence is claimed.
Owned headless Chrome and trusted synthetic mouse events; native GUI, physical devices and input-to-photon latency remain unverified.
Exact stored f64 composition is verified independently; inferred half interpolation allows3e-7 component error from f32 rounding.
Fresh public file input and captured download bytes are exercised; physical file-picker/download persistence is outside this harness.
Layer identity is its ordered stack index. Navigation/topology stay locked while layers exist; existing subdivision levels are retained after Bake.
Packed GPU vertex buffers cover positions, normals, mask and RGB at 40 bytes/vertex; no independent GPU index-buffer readback. Saved triangle correspondence/history are checked separately.

Short brush/idle intervals on the default sphere and an independently created coarse subdivision fixture do not establish long-session or large-layer performance; end-stroke capture/composition, normals and upload remain proportional to state size.
Fresh public input and captured download bytes do not establish physical file-picker interaction or disk download persistence.
timing_scope: Probe timestamps are start times after trusted DOM pointerup, before GPU readback completes; rAF callback gaps describe scheduling, not rendered frame time, physical input-to-photon latency or native latency. Incremental waits 0/200/800ms are measured through the helper, not absolute release deadlines.
